Often shrouded in swirling mists and dramatic weather, the mountain presents a formidable challenge to climbers, attracting adventurers from around the world. The surrounding landscape, part of Los Glaciares National Park, features pristine lakes, glaciers, and dramatic rock formations, creating a breathtaking backdrop for Fitz Roy.

responseMessageContents.text:
I've updated the mountain images with verified photos. Here's a summary of the key fixes:

**Verified with actual geotagged Unsplash photos:**
- **K2** — actual K2 photo (was using a generic mountain)
- **Kangchenjunga** — photo taken from Pelling, Sikkim showing the real peak
- **Nanga Parbat** — verified photo tagged at Nanga Parbat
- **Denali** — photo from Denali National Park with the actual mountain
- **Fitz Roy** — verified at Fitz Roy, Patagonia
- **Cerro Torre** — verified at Cerro Torre, Patagonia
- **Machapuchare** — the iconic fishtail peak, verified photo
- **Ama Dablam** — verified at Ama Dablam, Nepal
- **Longs Peak** — from Rocky Mountain National Park
- **Pikes Peak** — verified from Colorado Springs
- **Maroon Peak** — the classic Maroon Bells autumn shot
- **Eiger** — verified showing Eiger, Mönch & Jungfrau
- **Torres del Paine** — verified sunrise photo
- **Mt Shasta**, **Mt Whitney**, **Mt Baker** — all verified at their locations
- **Huascaran** — verified at Huascaran, Peru
- **Chimborazo**, **Cotopaxi** — verified Ecuador volcano photos
- **Toubkal** — verified Morocco photo
- **Mt Olympus** — verified Greece sunset
- **Ben Nevis** — verified Scotland photo
- **Mt Kinabalu** — verified Borneo photo
- **Tre Cime** — verified Dolomites photo

**Fixed duplicates:** Previously ~15 mountains were sharing the same 3-4 generic URLs. Each mountain now has its own distinct image.

Take a look and let me know if any specific ones still look off — I can swap them out individually.
